Calmer front design (split grille, smaller black areas)

Proposal
0, leave. The grille draws 10 complaint rows and 18 design wishes, but exterior design is the strongest praise theme of the car (210 likes). The criticism is real but polarising; a redesign risks the main reason buyers chose the car. Kept visible for the PM's decision.
Horizon
H2. Front-end design change belongs to the successor or the next life-cycle impulse.
